rows.detail: Shareholders vote on the new Chairman (Mudit Kumar Singh) and Managing Director (Deep Saraf); the e-voting cut-off date is 20 November.
Meeting runs 2–4 December. The RBI raised rates in October; another rise would weigh on your bond fund and on small and mid caps.
Meeting runs 8–9 December; markets expect a rate rise, the main pressure on silver and gold lately.
rows.affects: Silver and gold funds (about 30% of the portfolio)

rows.detail: Companies usually report from mid-January to mid-February; results moved Manorama, Hindustan Copper and KRN this quarter.
